meta.purpose: Verified free-to-use stock photo catalog for AI-built auto repair shop websites. Download and bundle the files; do not hotlink.
meta.orientation_rule: Computed from the original pixel size. landscape: width/height > 1.25; portrait: width/height < 0.8; square: 0.8 to 1.25 inclusive (can be cropped to 1:1 with little loss).

field_notes.width_height: Original upload size in pixels (Unsplash: from imgix fm=json; Pexels and Pixabay: from the photo page). rendition_1200_size is the size actually returned by image_url_1200.
field_notes.identifiable_people: true when a recognisable face is visible. All such photos show people in a positive or neutral work/family context. Do not imply endorsement by the people shown.
field_notes.notes: Minor incidental text or marks left after review (small device labels, tire sidewall text, part codes). No prominent brand logo and no readable license plate remain in the catalog.
field_notes.best_use: hero = wide landscape suited to a full-width banner; service = illustrates a service page; gallery = general gallery; about = people and shop-team shots; cta = key handoff, handshake and family shots for call-to-action blocks.

rendition_rules.unsplash: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-<id>?w=1200&q=75&fm=webp (and w=600). Swap fm=webp for fm=jpg if a JPEG fallback is needed.
rendition_rules.pixabay: https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/<path>_1280.jpg (1280 px wide, closest to 1200) and _640.jpg (640 wide, closest to 600). Pixabay only offers fixed sizes.
